verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring captures production traces, conversations and LLM calls, and lets you compare models and prompts. The evidence never mentions curating datasets from those traces or running offline evaluations against them. Trace viewing and model comparison are adjacent observability features, not the evals-datasets capability, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them
